# PhysioPro

> Performance rehabilitation clinic in Zona Rio, Tijuana, Mexico, led by Leonardo Machado, a licensed physiotherapist. Founder-led, one-to-one clinical care for pain, injury, post-surgical recovery, and return to sport — not a passive-modality or massage clinic.

Key facts: address Jose Maria Velazco 2632, Zona Urbana Rio, Tijuana, Baja California, 22010, Mexico. Phone/WhatsApp +52 663 487 5859. Hours Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM–8:00 PM. Services are provided in Mexico under Mexican law; PhysioPro does not claim U.S. licensure or U.S. regulatory equivalence.

## Core pages

- [Home](https://physioprotijuana.com/): Clinic overview, positioning, and booking entry points.
- [First Session](https://physioprotijuana.com/first-session): What to expect at the initial evaluation.
- [About Leonardo](https://physioprotijuana.com/about-leonardo): Founder background and credentials.
- [Ask Leonardo](https://physioprotijuana.com/ask-leonardo): Direct question form to the founder before booking.
- [Contact](https://physioprotijuana.com/contact): Location, hours, phone, and WhatsApp.
- [FAQ](https://physioprotijuana.com/faq): Common questions about evaluation, pricing, and process.
- [Who We Help](https://physioprotijuana.com/who-we-help): Patient/athlete profiles PhysioPro treats.
- [What We Treat](https://physioprotijuana.com/what-we-treat): Conditions and injury categories.
